title: pvResourcePVLookupTable
body:
## pvResourcePVLookupTable

Typed colour lookup-table resource (vtkPVDiscretizableColorTransferFunction) that maps data values to colours, either as a continuous colour map defined by RGBPoints control points or as categorical colours for annotated values (InterpretValuesAsCategories). It is not a dataset: it is connected to lookup-table inputs such as pvColorByArray, pvOMETIFFChannelCalculator or the PLY and OpenVDB writers, and several consumers can share one table. Scene appearances build their own colour maps from field, range and preset, so use this resource only for those explicit ports.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- RGBPoints positions are data values; ParaView's GUI usually rescales a new map to the data range, but here nothing rescales it, so set positions that cover your array's range.
- Optional ScalarOpacityFunction and TransferFunction2D inputs accept pvResourcePiecewiseFunction and pvResourceTransferFunction2D nodes.
- Exercised by examples/schemaxis/paraview-resources.json and paraview-writer-resources.json (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json); other settings are unverified.

Native constructor: `PVLookupTable`. Identity: `lookup_tables/PVLookupTable`. Role: `resource`. Output kinds: `["lookup-table"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ScalarOpacityFunction` | Optional: the opacity transfer-function resource (a pvResourcePiecewiseFunction node) used by the native ScalarOpacityFunction property. Give the id of that resource node in this document. Resources are configuration objects, not data results, so no output port can be selected. | False | one object | `piecewise-function` | `{"compatibility":"native-proxy-group","cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","rating":"unknown"},"nativeGroup":"piecewise_functions"}` |
| `TransferFunction2D` | Optional: the 2D transfer-function resource (a pvResourceTransferFunction2D node) used by the native TransferFunction2D property. Give the id of that resource node in this document. Resources are configuration objects, not data results, so no output port can be selected. ParaView: Proxy property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to store a 2D transfer function (vtkImageData). | False | one object | `transfer-function-2d` | `{"compatibility":"native-proxy-group","cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","rating":"unknown"},"nativeGroup":"transfer_2d_functions"}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AboveRangeColor` | Set the color to use when a data value is above the range of the color map. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ActiveAnnotatedValues` | Specify active annotations. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `AllowDuplicateScalars` | Whether two RGBPoints control points may share the same data value. True keeps both, which creates a sharp colour jump at that value; false makes a later point replace an earlier one at the same position. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Annotations` | Specify annotations. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `AnnotationsInitialized` | Set to 1 to indicate that the annotations have been initialized. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AutomaticDataHistogramComputation` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know if the data histogram should be automatically computed | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `AutomaticRescaleRangeMode` | Choose whether and how to automatically rescale the color map range. "Never" means the color map range will never be changed. "Grow and update on 'Apply'" will expand the range to contain the union of the current range and the range of the current data source. "Grow and update every timestep" will expand the range to contain the union of the current range and the range of the current data source when the timestep is changed. "Clamp and update every timestep" will update the color map range to the current source data range. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Never","Grow and update on 'Apply'","Grow and update every timestep","Update on 'Apply'","Clamp and update every timestep"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Never"` |
| `BelowRangeColor` | Set the color to use when a data value is below the range of the color map. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ColorSpace` | The color space used for interpolation: RGB, HSV, Lab (CIELAB), or Diverging. In HSV mode, if HSVWrap is on, it will take the shortest path in Hue (going back through 0 if that is the shortest way around the hue circle) whereas if HSVWrap is off it will not go through 0 (in order the match the current functionality of vtkLookupTable). Diverging is a special mode where colors will pass through white when interpolating between two saturated colors. In Lab/CIEDE2000 mode, it will take the shortest path in the Lab color space with respect to the CIE Delta E 2000 color distance measure. In Step mode, the color of an interval is the color of the second point of the interval. | `{"type":"enum","values":["RGB","HSV","Lab","Diverging","Lab/CIEDE2000","Step"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"RGB"` |
| `DataHistogramNumberOfBins` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know the number of bin to use to compute the data histogram | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Discretize` | When set, the color transfer function will comprise of discrete colors with number of discrete colors specified using NumberOfTableValues. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `EnableOpacityMapping` | When enabled, the opacity transfer function is used for rendering, if applicable. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `HSVWrap` | Only used when ColorSpace is HSV: true lets hue interpolation take the shorter way round the colour wheel, passing through red (hue 0) if that is shorter; false never crosses hue 0, matching vtkLookupTable. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `IndexedColors` | Colors used when using IndexedLookup is true. Complete tuples of 3 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `IndexedOpacities` | Opacities used when using IndexedLookup is true. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `InterpretValuesAsCategories` | When enabled, the color transfer function switches to indexed-lookup (categorical colors) mode. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NanColor` | Set the color to use when NaN (not-a-number) is encountered. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `NanOpacity` | Set the opacity to use when NaN (not-a-number) is encountered. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `NumberOfTableValues` | When Discretize is set, this specifies the number of discrete colors that must be present in the transfer function. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `RGBPoints` | Specify the control points that form the color-transfer-function. These are a list of 4-tuples of the form (x, r, g, b) where x is the data value, and r,g,b are three color components in the range [0,1]. Complete tuples of 4 values. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `RescaleOnVisibilityChange` | Flag indicating whether the color map data range should be updated when a representation's visibility changes. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ScalarRangeInitialized` | Set to 1 to indicate that the scalar range has been initialized. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ShowCategoricalColorsinDataRangeOnly` | When interpreting values as categories, enabling this option results in the display of only the 'active' categorical colors for values in the data range, i.e., values that exist in the source. You may need to click the 'Rescale to Data Range' button to update the active values that are displayed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ShowDataHistogram` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know if the data histogram should be shown | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseAboveRangeColor` | Use special color to use when a data value is above the range of the color map. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseBelowRangeColor` | Use special color to use when a data value is below the range of the color map. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseLogScale` | Maps data values to colours on a base-10 logarithmic scale, so equal ratios (10 to 100, 100 to 1000) get equal colour steps. Useful for quantities spanning several orders of magnitude; the RGBPoints positions stay in data units. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseOpacityControlPointsFreehandDrawing` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know if freehand drawing should be used | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Using2DTransferFunction` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know if a 2D transfer function is being used. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UsingSeparateOpacityArray` | Proxy only property used by the ColorOpacityWidget to know if a separate array is being used to map opacity in volume rendering. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VectorComponent` | Zero-based component of a multi-component array to colour by when VectorMode is Component (0 = x or first component, 1 = y, 2 = z). Ignored in Magnitude mode and for single-component arrays. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `VectorMode` | How a multi-component array (for example velocity) becomes a single value for colouring: Magnitude uses the vector length, Component uses the one component chosen by VectorComponent. Single-component arrays are unaffected. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Magnitude","Component"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Magnitude"` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResourcePVLookupTable"
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["Build"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
